questions.prompt: Which medication is a documented Look-Alike / Sound-Alike counterpart to Abelcet?
questions.explanation: Abelcet is frequently confused with conventional amphotericin B due to similar generic roots.

questions.prompt: Which medication is an ISMP-documented look-alike counterpart to acetaZOLAMIDE?
questions.explanation: acetaZOLAMIDE and acetoHEXAMIDE differ only in minor vowel stems (aceta- vs aceto-) and suffixes.

questions.prompt: Which corticosteroid is a documented look-alike counterpart to predniSONE?
questions.explanation: predniSONE and prednisoLONE differ by only one syllable and are frequently confused.
